notes.name: kicad.md
notes.text:
KiCad GUI recipes from infrared_driver:
- Use lowercase key names (`home`, `esc`). Uppercase Home is rejected.
- Symbol chooser search accepts Device:Battery, Device:R, Device:LED, power:+9V, power:GND. Inspect chooser after opening before typing. OK at normalized (698,828).
- `r` once rotates the default resistor horizontal; twice rotates default LED so anode left, cathode right.
- Hover `e` opens properties; Value was at (350,413), OK (758,788). Ctrl+D duplicates symbol with next reference and same value/orientation.
- `w` at pin starts wire, click corners and final pin, then esc. Use visible grid-aligned endpoints.
- Scroll zoom initially confusing; lowercase home centers page; f1 zoom worked.
- Save with ctrl+s and inspect title for removal of * before termination.
